name: Fork · Death · Arcane
primary:
Lightning shoots from your hand into the creature you aim at (or the first one in your line of sight). In instant mode it strikes twice a second while held. Effects:
• Damage 6.25 ❤ lightning + 3 ❤ arcane (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 189: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 12 targets in a row, jumps up to 7 blocks, 3.15 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 6 s
• Life drain: 1 ❤ damage, you heal 0.52 ❤
• Arcane instability: −0.75 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
